newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek C/A shows surplus of $140.7mln in Dec 96.
newsitem.headline: Greek C/A shows surplus of $140.7mln in Dec 96.

text.p: Greece's current account balance of payments showed a surplus of $140.7 million in December 1996 compared with a surplus of $173.3 million in the same month of 1995, the Bank of Greece said.
The 1996 current account deficit rose 59.2 percent year-on-year to $4.5 billion.

The larger cumulative current account deficit in 1996 reflects a 7.1 percent increase in the trade deficit to $18.3 billion and a 3.3 percent decrease in the surplus of invisibles to $13.8 billion, it said.
The larger trade deficit in 1996 was due to a 5.3 percent rise in imports to $24.1 billion with fuel imports up 29.2 percent and exports flat at $5.76 billion, the central bank said.
Net private capital inflows rose to $7.2 billion in 1996 from $2.3 billion in 1995, it said.
Forex reserves stood at $19.17 billion ta the end of 1996 versus $15.4 billion in 1995, it added.
